grains.RAW.SETTLEMENT_DAILY: one row per buyer counterparty per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.SHIPPING_DOCUMENTS: one row per buyer counterparty (document snapshot)
grains.CURATED.PRODUCT_SUMMARY: one row per palm oil product
grains.ML.LATE_RISK_SCORES: one row per buyer counterparty (latest day)

metrics.Exposure >30d Overdue: 100 * SUM(OPEN_EXPOSURE_USD WHERE DAYS_OVERDUE > 30) / SUM(OPEN_EXPOSURE_USD), latest day

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.late_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(buyer settles an invoice late in the next 14 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout; buyers already more than 30 days overdue are excluded from training and evaluation
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day desk-wide late-settlement FORECAST; letter-of-credit headroom ANOMALY_DETECTION per buyer (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.SETTLEMENT_SOP_SEARCH over 15 synthetic settlement playbooks (5 products x 3 overdue stages)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.TRADING_DESK_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.CREDIT_DESK_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and playbook citations; the action memo uses only KPI, counterparty, product and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (buyer count, daily settlements, late settlements by counterparty, late-settlement risk, settlement events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_SETTLEMENTS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_SETTLEMENT_ALERT logs new LATE events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
